tasks.task: Pitch an offline presentation editor to developers. It keeps text editable and saves local copies. Produce one concise opening slide. Do not invent adoption or speed claims.
用简体中文解释本地优先的工作流，保留 JSON、HTML、PowerPoint 产品名。给出三个简短步骤：整理大纲、检查排版、导出副本。

A supplied internal QA log says 8 of 10 sample decks passed first check; 2 needed shorter titles. This is a sample, not a population estimate. Compare the outcomes, cite only source qa-log, and mention that limitation in the script.

Plan an image-caption slide showing an original local abstract star illustration. No image generation or network. Describe useful alt text and an offline text fallback. The image is decoration, not scientific evidence.

Compare two routes: local HTML exploration and static editable PowerPoint. Make two concise items and two matching tab labels. Explain a static fallback that displays both choices. Keep every word editable.

Repair this pure JavaScript function: function nextIndex(index,count){ return Math.min(count,index+1); }. Return a function named nextIndex that clamps to 0..count-1, returns 0 for count<=0, and works for -1, 0 and the last index. No imports, eval, network or tools. Explain the repair as a process slide with three items.
